text: Assumption: The asynchronous semantics mean that the hardware adoption of the duty cycle occurs delayed or at the period change — is this correct?

assumption: The asynchronous semantics mean that the hardware adoption of the duty cycle occurs delayed or at the period change.
rationale: The payload declares Sync/Async as Asynchronous, but does not further describe the exact timing of the hardware adoption.

original.rationale: Der Payload deklariert Sync/Async als Asynchronous, beschreibt aber das genaue Timing der Hardware-Übernahme nicht weiter.
